Viewpoint 1.summary: Taxation should be based on the economic community, so aggregated taxation should be imposed on the real estate holdings of companies in Group P.

Viewpoint 2.summary: Imposing aggregate taxation only on registered groups creates unfairness between Group P and unregistered Group Q, so each company should be taxed individually.

c1.text: Real estate holding tax rates: up to 500 million won is 0.5%, over 500 million up to 1 billion won is 1.5%, over 1 billion up to 2 billion won is 2.5%, over 2 billion won is 3.5%.

c2.text: Alice and Bob belong to registered Group P, while Charlie and Diane belong to unregistered entity Q.

c3.text: Under current tax law, real estate held by each company is taxed individually.

c4.text: Aggregated taxation should be imposed on the real estate holdings of the companies within Group P.

c5.text: Taxation should be carried out based on the unit of the economic community.

c6.text: Companies within a single group registered in the corporate registry can be viewed as an economic community.

c7.text: Each company should be taxed individually according to the current tax law, regardless of group registration status.

c8.text: If aggregate taxation is imposed only on registered groups, Group P ends up paying more taxes than Group Q despite both being economic communities, resulting in an unfair outcome.

c9.text: Companies run by the Q family also have the characteristics of an economic community.

ha1.text: The total real estate value of the companies in Group P does not exceed 500 million won.

ha2.text: The total tax amount for Group P will not differ whether taxation is according to Viewpoint 1 or Viewpoint 2.

a.note: When total value <= 500 million won, both aggregate and individual taxation apply the 0.5% rate, so the total tax amount is identical and ha2 is IN.

hb1.text: The total real estate value of the companies in Group P exceeds 2 billion won.

hb2.text: There is no situation in which the total tax amount for Group P is the same under Viewpoint 1 and Viewpoint 2.

hb3.text: If each company in Group P owns real estate exceeding 2 billion won, both Viewpoint 1 and Viewpoint 2 apply the 3.5% tax rate, resulting in the same total tax amount.

b.note: The naive inference rb1 concluding hb2 is undercut and rebutted by hb3, causing hb2 to be OUT rather than IN.

hc1.text: The tax law is revised to treat substantive economic entities like Q as groups registered in the corporate registry.

hc2.text: Unregistered economic communities like Q are also subject to aggregate taxation, eliminating the unfairness between P and Q.

c.note: Viewpoint 2's objection to aggregate taxation on P was its thesis c7 via rule r2 based on unfairness c8. Revising the law to treat Q as registered eliminates that unfairness (hc2), undercutting r2 so Viewpoint 2's thesis is OUT.
